surface: Codex in-app Chromium, same-machine sequential run
method: Expand existing instances into equivalent separate meshes sharing geometry and materials. Same generated world, three rats, camera, lights, viewport. This isolates batching; it is not a historical whole-game comparison.
interpretation: Draw calls decreased 52.6%; batch culling submitted 32.1% more triangles. Frame median and render CPU p95 did not improve. No FPS gain established. Geometry counts match because expanded controls intentionally share resources. See world-scenery-benchmark.json for historical allocation counts.
